placements.why: This envelope's entire content is a ratified technical contract governing how a system call behaves (return semantics, failure guarantees, retrieval paths) — an architecture-grain concern with no existing strata category to hold it. Minting Architecture as a bare top-level category lets this and future design-contract envelopes nest under it without forcing a false fit into a non-existent Product or Organization category.
placements.title: System design commitments as their own organizational category
placements.frame: What structural or technical design commitment is this content anchoring or extending?

placements.title: Async operations return immediately and are tracked rather than awaited
placements.frame: What guarantee, failure mode, or retrieval mechanism of the async remember contract is being confirmed, extended, or revised here?
placements.why: All three segments cohere as one ratified theme rather than three separate facts: src-1 states the core mechanism (immediate receipt, cursor-polled extraction), src-2 states the design's negative guarantees (no blocking, no lost work), and src-3 states the retrieval flow (poll or piggyback). None is a one-time measurement or proof point — each is a durable statement about how this async contract behaves, the kind of thing future envelopes about this same job pattern will keep feeding (confirming the receipt latency holds, adding a new retrieval path, revising the no-lost-work guarantee). The position pass already grouped these as one converged take, reinforcing that they share a single thematic subject rather than three independent leaves.
